We have applied three templates sequentially, got precursors at each step.

First step (template 324324) gave two products: product1: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1" and product2: "Nc1ccccc1N". So the retrosynthetic step splits target into these two precursors.

Second step (template 1914396) applied to first precursor gave: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1" and "O=C(O)CC(=O)O". So further split.

Third step (template 733) applied to that first precursor gave? We haven't applied yet; we just checked matching. Need to apply to get precursors. Let's apply template 733 to "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1".
